signaling_waveforms.Idle_J: D+ HIGH, D- LOW (FS) or inverted (LS); HS = both squelched
signaling_waveforms.K_state: D+ LOW, D- HIGH (FS) or inverted (LS)
signaling_waveforms.SE0: D+ LOW, D- LOW (used for EOP at FS/LS and for Reset)
signaling_waveforms.EOP_FS_LS: SE0 for 2 bit times + idle J for 1 bit time
signaling_waveforms.Reset: SE0 ≥ 10 ms driven by host or hub
signaling_waveforms.Resume_K: K-state ≥ 20 ms by host or 1..15 ms by device (remote wakeup)
signaling_waveforms.HS_chirp_K: Device drives K-state 1..7 ms after Reset to indicate HS capability
signaling_waveforms.HS_chirp_K_J_response: Hub responds with K-J-K-J-K-J alternating ≥ 50 µs each, ≥ 6 chirps
